subject.title: Unpack a packed hold to Not shipped

question: Should Bobby approve merging the v8 persisted reservation-status rename with `stock.unpack`?
rationale: The repository requires Bobby's explicit merge approval, and the migration changes a persisted reservation value that external consumers could deserialize.

options.title: Approve the bounded migration
options.body: Approve the PR after confirming `not_shipped` is the intended replacement for persisted open reservation status.

options.title: Audit consumers first
options.body: Pause merging until consumers of the predecessor `active` status have been identified or shown not to exist.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded migration
recommendation.body: Approve the PR after confirming `not_shipped` is the intended replacement for persisted open reservation status.

likelyOwner.reason: AGENTS.md explicitly names Bobby as the required approver for merges.
